definitions.explanation: An orbit shaped like an ellipse, in which the orbiting body's distance from the central object varies over the course of one revolution.

examples.japanese: {月|つき}は{楕円軌道|だえんきどう}を{描|えが}く。
examples.english: The moon traces an elliptical orbit.

examples.japanese: {地球|ちきゅう}は{太陽|たいよう}の{周|まわ}りを{楕円軌道|だえんきどう}で{回|まわ}る。
examples.english: The Earth moves around the sun in an elliptical orbit.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}くの{惑星|わくせい}は{完全|かんぜん}な{円|えん}ではなく{楕円軌道|だえんきどう}を{持|も}つ。
examples.english: Most planets have elliptical orbits rather than perfect circles.

notes:
USAGE: {楕円軌道|だえんきどう} is an elliptical (oval) orbit, in which the orbiting body's speed and distance vary. It combines {楕円|だえん} (ellipse) with {軌道|きどう} (orbit).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {楕円軌道|だえんきどう}を{描|えが}く: to trace an elliptical orbit
- {楕円軌道|だえんきどう}を{回|まわ}る: to move in an elliptical orbit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {円軌道|えんきどう}: circular orbit — constant distance from the center
- {静止軌道|せいしきどう}: geostationary orbit
